# session

```go
import "github.com/aexvir/skladka/internal/session"
```

Package session provides functionality for managing user and WebAuthn sessions.

It handles: \- Creating and managing user sessions \- Storing WebAuthn session data during registration/login \- Session cleanup and expiration

The package uses postgres for session storage and integrates with the user package for authentication flows.

## Constants

<a name="SessionTokenLength"></a>

```go
const (
    // SessionTokenLength is the number of random bytes for session tokens
    SessionTokenLength = 32
    // DefaultSessionDuration is the default time a session remains valid
    DefaultSessionDuration = 24 * time.Hour
    // WebAuthnSessionDuration is how long a WebAuthn session remains valid
    WebAuthnSessionDuration = 5 * time.Minute
)
```
